answer: DUNE-VINE VOUCHING: standing is a velvet-smoothed 12-epoch average of the scores earned by the peers you attested. Every vouch is appended to your public dune-vine: who you backed, what their answer later scored. A farm vouching for its own puppets poisons its own standing: template answers score low, so each vouch decays the vouching agent's average and the dune-vine exposes the cluster. Keeping standing means every puppet producing good work — creative cost scaling linearly with puppet count — or accepting the decay; the velvet window stops a good-epoch burst hiding a long farm streak.
